people.last_admin: This is the only administrator. Make someone else an administrator first.
people.roles_intro: A role is a set of permissions: what a person may view, edit, publish and delete. Built-in roles cannot be changed, but they can be copied and the copy adjusted. Custom roles are created and changed by the site administrator.
people.roles_builtin_note: A built-in role cannot be changed: its permissions adjust themselves to the structure of the site.
people.roles_builtin_copy_hint: To set it up your own way, make a copy.
people.roles_desc_placeholder: What this role is for, in one phrase
people.roles_2fa_help: People with this role need a code from an app on their phone after the password. Anyone who has not set it up yet will do so in their profile first. Applied at once, no “{save}” button needed.
people.roles_unsaved: Role permissions changed but not saved yet
people.roles_new_help: A new role starts with no permissions. Select the ones you need on the next step. Or copy a similar role with the “{duplicate}” button.
people.roles_delete_unassigned: The role is not assigned to anyone. This cannot be undone.

people.roles_delete_users.one: {count} user has this role: {names}. To delete the role, move them to another one.
people.roles_delete_users.other: {count} users have this role: {names}. To delete the role, move them to another one.

people.roles_name_too_long: The name is longer than 40 characters
people.roles_name_taken: A role with this name already exists
people.roles_template_required: Choose at least one template or go back to “{all}”
people.roles_leave_message: The role has unsaved changes. If you leave, they will be lost.
people.roles_created: Role “{name}” created: select what it may do
people.roles_copied: Role “{name}” created: you can now change it
people.roles_copied_trimmed: Role “{name}” created: you can now change it. Permissions your role does not have were left out of the copy
people.roles_2fa_on: Two-step sign-in is now required for role “{name}”
people.roles_2fa_off: Two-step sign-in is no longer required for role “{name}”
people.roles_readonly_note: View only: your role cannot change roles or users. You can see which permissions each role has.
people.users_intro: Who can sign in to the admin panel of this site. What a person may do is set by their role: roles are configured on the “{roles}” tab. Changes apply at once.
people.users_readonly_note: View only: your role cannot change users. You can see who is on the team and what role each person has.
people.users_empty_text: Check the spelling or clear the search and the role filter.
people.users_invite_help_mail: The person will get an email with a link to set their own password. The link is valid for 7 days.
people.users_invite_help_nomail: Site mail is not set up: the site will generate a password for the person and show it to you, so pass it on yourself. To send invitations by email, set up “Settings → Mail”.
people.users_roles_too_big: Roles with more permissions than yours cannot be chosen.
people.users_err_email: Enter an email address: it is the sign-in login
people.users_err_email_typo: There seems to be a typo in the email address
people.users_err_email_taken: A user with this email already exists
people.drawer_why_block_me: This is you: you cannot block yourself.
people.drawer_why_delete_me: This is you: you cannot delete yourself.
people.drawer_why_role_me: You cannot change your own role: ask another administrator.
people.drawer_close_message: Changes to the name, email or role will be lost.
people.drawer_link_title: Send a link for a new password: {name}?
people.drawer_link_message: An email with a link will be sent to {email}: the person will set a new password through it. Until then, the old password keeps working.
people.drawer_reset_message: The old password will stop working, and this person’s open sessions will end. The site will generate a new password and show it to you once: pass it on to the person yourself.
people.drawer_tf_message: Use this if the person lost their phone and recovery codes. They will sign in with the password and set up two-step sign-in again (required if their role demands it).
people.drawer_block_message: The person will not be able to sign in to the admin panel until you unblock them. Their edits and publications will stay.
people.drawer_delete_message: They will lose access to the admin panel. Pages and records they edited will stay as they are. This cannot be undone.
people.drawer_delete_help: Access will be gone for good. Pages and records they edited will stay.
people.drawer_act_link: Send a link for a new password
people.drawer_pw_me: This is you: you change your own password in your profile (click your name at the bottom left).
people.drawer_pw_mail: The person will get an email with a link to set a new password. The old password works until a new one is set.
people.drawer_pw_nomail: The site will generate a new password and show it to you once. Pass it on to the person yourself: site mail is not set up. The old password will stop working.
people.drawer_tf_help: This person signs in with a code from an app. If they lost their phone and recovery codes, reset it: they will set it up again.
people.drawer_unblock_help: The person will be able to sign in to the admin panel again.
people.drawer_block_help: The person will not be able to sign in until you unblock them. Their edits will stay.
people.otp_copy_failed: Could not copy: select the password and copy it manually
people.otp_mail_failed: The email with a link could not be sent: {error}
people.otp_note: Pass this password on to the person yourself. After signing in, they should change it in their profile.
people.otp_once: The password is shown once. If you close the window without copying it, click “{reset}” again.
people.matrix_empty: The role has no permissions yet: users with it will see only “Today”. Select what they may do.
people.matrix_box_locked: {action}: {area} (your role does not have this permission)
people.matrix_locked_title: Your role does not have this permission
people.matrix_na_title: This section has no such permission
people.matrix_na: {action}: the section “{area}” has no such permission
people.matrix_scope_help: In lists, this person sees and can create only pages of the chosen templates. All other pages are closed to them.
people.matrix_note: “{publish}” and “{delete}” work only together with “{edit}”, and “{edit}” works only with “{view}”: the needed boxes are checked automatically.
